answer: Beaconed Pseudonym Auction. 1) A shared randomness beacon emits a pseudorandom number sequence. 2) Each identity, acting as a 'copper', bids a unique pseudonym and a staked amount. 3) The highest staked pseudonym for each beacon number wins. A 'jetty' manages these auctions. 'Basalt' stores the pseudonym-identity mapping. Cost: $5 N^2$ for N identities. Failure Condition: A single entity controlling the beacon and multiple high-stake 'coppers'.
